statements: CREATE TABLE documents(path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, document_id TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('INDEXED','EMPTY','SKIPPED_REDACTED')), original_window_count INTEGER NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL, metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, rows_json TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE chunks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, path TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(path), chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, start_token INTEGER NOT NULL, end_token INTEGER NOT NULL, start_byte INTEGER NOT NULL, end_byte INTEGER NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, snippet TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(start_token<end_token AND start_byte<end_byte), UNIQUE(path,chunk_index)) STRICT
CREATE TABLE chunk_hash(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES chunks(id), h BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(h)=32)) STRICT
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunk_fts USING fts5(text, content='chunks', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2')

CREATE TABLE meta(format INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(format=1), generation_id TEXT NOT NULL, kb_id TEXT NOT NULL, commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(dimensions BETWEEN 1 AND 2000), quantization TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(quantization IN('int8','binary_int8_rescore')), int8_scale REAL NOT NULL CHECK(int8_scale>0), document_count INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, vec_version TEXT NOT NULL, host_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

int8: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunk_vec USING vec0(slice integer partition key, embedding int8[{dims}] distance_metric=cosine)
binary_int8_rescore: CREATE TABLE chunk_bits(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, b BLOB NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE TABLE chunk_int8(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, e BLOB NOT NULL) STRICT

lexicalMetaStatement: CREATE TABLE meta(format INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(format=1), generation_id TEXT NOT NULL, kb_id TEXT NOT NULL, commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT CHECK(fingerprint IS NULL), dimensions INTEGER CHECK(dimensions IS NULL), quantization TEXT CHECK(quantization IS NULL), int8_scale REAL CHECK(int8_scale IS NULL), document_count INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, vec_version TEXT NOT NULL, host_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
